risks.title: Compatibility stack remains much larger than the new MVP substrate
risks.signal: New work keeps extending run_local_pipeline_impl, formal delivery, or old planning contracts instead of the CapabilityTree substrate.
risks.response: Treat the pre-reset Provider generation and formal-delivery stack as compatibility/future material; require product_direction_gate for architecture changes.

risks.title: Multiple planning and graph abstractions compete for authority
risks.signal: CapabilityTree, WorkNode, ProviderJob, decomposition tree, module flow, or planning proposal each acts as a project-level source of truth.
risks.response: Make CapabilityTree the composition truth and ExecutionDAG the execution truth; keep other structures as adapters or migrate them out.

risks.title: High-capability Agent is not yet wired as the composition authority
risks.signal: A cheap Provider still performs whole-project planning or the Agent only audits after decisions are made.
risks.response: Define bounded Agent tree-edit actions and keep executor tasks local to a node.

risks.title: Executor interfaces remain fragmented
risks.signal: Provider, local model, search, script, browser, and tests require separate scheduling or result semantics.
risks.response: Consolidate them behind the common Component/Block execute contract and result envelope.

risks.title: Legacy tests encode superseded architecture
risks.signal: Full pytest fails because tests require Fixed10, role-driven validation, mandatory Provider planning, or old delivery authority wording.
risks.response: Archive tests together with retired paths and retain focused tests for still-supported compatibility behavior.

risks.title: No real end-to-end MVP vertical slice yet
risks.signal: Tree and DAG unit tests pass but no real project change reaches execution, testing, and Agent completion judgment.
risks.response: Prioritize one small real project over scale, stress, or broad benchmark coverage.

risks.title: Self-growth could become unrestricted self-modification
risks.signal: A discovered capability changes kernel invariants or bypasses interface/test registration.
risks.response: Limit self-growth to search, bounded trial, validated Block integration, registry admission, and measured reuse.

risks.title: Project-team features may reintroduce fixed role pipelines
risks.signal: PM, Developer, QA, Researcher, or Marketing becomes a required sequential stage.
risks.response: Represent roles only as optional capability bundles/views over the same tree and DAG.

risks.title: Repository CI may not execute on the isolated branch
risks.signal: Workflow runs show startup failure or no jobs/status checks.
risks.response: Record CI as NOT_EVALUATED, keep the branch unmerged, and run the focused gate locally before promotion.
